claim.claim-text: 1. A first base station (106) comprising:

2. The first base station (106) of claim 1, wherein the code is further executable to cause the one or more processors (142) to control the first base station (106) to: insert an indication in the second data stream sent to the destination device (110), wherein the indication identifies the second data stream as having a lower network priority than the first data stream.
3. The first base station (106) of claim 2, wherein the indication comprises a "1" bit at the beginning of the bits in the code shortened form of the data steam.

4. The first base station (106) of claim 3, wherein the 1 bit indicates to network routing nodes that the bits from the second data stream (107) may be truncated if necessary or dropped if congestion occurs.
5. The first base station (106) of claim 1, wherein intercepting (204) the at least the portion of the first data stream comprises intercepting (204) an incomplete portion of the code word.
6. The first base station (106) of claim 1, wherein the code shortened form of the first data stream is redundant to the data in the first data stream.
7. The first base station (106) of claim 1, wherein the first base station (106) has a priority to receive transmissions other than transmissions from the source device (104).
8. The first base station (106) of claim 1, wherein the code is further executable to cause the one or more processors (142) to control the first base station (106) to:

receive and collect data from IoT sensor devices (103a, 103b, 103c); and wherein intercepting (204) the at least the portion of the first data stream comprises intercepting (204) the at least the portion of the first data stream in free periods of time available to the first base station (106) during which the first baste station (106) is not receiving data from the IoT sensor devices.

9. The first base station (106) of claim 1, wherein: controlling the first base station to determine that the first base station (106) has available bandwidth to receive at least the portion of the first data stream comprises controlling the first base station (106) to determine that the first base station (106) has available bandwidth that is not being used for receiving data sent to the first base station (106).

10. The first base station (106) of claim 9, wherein the code is further executable to cause the one or more processors (142) to control the first base station (106) to: in response to the determination that the first base station (106) has available bandwidth, scan to locate the wireless channel and intercept the at least the portion of the data stream.
11. The first base station (106) of claim 1, further comprising:

a decoder that decodes the shortened version of the code word; and wherein sending (206) the code shortened form of the data stream to the destination device (110) comprises sending the output of the decoder to the destination device (110).

12. The first base station (106) of claim 1, wherein: intercepting (204) the at least the portion of the first data stream as the code shortened form of the first data stream comprises controlling, by the one or more processors (142), the first base station (106) to receive appropriate bits based on a time available for receiving the code shortened form of the first data stream.

13. The first base station (106) of claim 12, wherein the receiving appropriate bits comprises receiving appropriate bits according to bandwidth allocations assigned by the one or more processors (142).
14. A system comprising:
15. The system of claim 14, wherein the source device (102) encodes the first data stream using a Reed-Solomon code, a trellis/convolutional code or a sequential coding with a time stopping window.
